scope: One complete Task1.zip byte object; acquired brain CT/MRI are the sole candidate scientific component. Other members remain unreviewed and no images are opened.

dataset.title: SynthRAD2023 Grand Challenge dataset: synthetizing computed tomography for radiotherapy

rights.permitted_project_scope: Noncommercial research only under source license; retain attribution, license link and indicate changes when sharing derivatives.

attribution.title: SynthRAD2023 Grand Challenge dataset: synthetizing computed tomography for radiotherapy

rights.preprocessing_code_license: Repository listing reports GPL-3.0 for preprocessing code; that separate code license does not replace dataset CC-BY-NC-4.0.

sources.measured_sha256: Record after complete local verification; never present as publisher SHA256.

lineage.acquisition_origin: Provider reports clinical CT and MRI acquired for radiotherapy planning, including T1-weighted MRI. They are acquired images released after preprocessing, not CT generated by a synthesis model.
provider_preprocessing: Rigid registration of CT and MRI
lineage.original_definition: Preserve exact publisher archive bytes and released acquired CT/MRI. This is not a claim of untouched scanner DICOM or native geometry.
lineage.mask: Provider mask is a dilated patient outline; it is not an annotated skull, tumor, vessel, or surgical corridor.
excluded: Provider outline as human anatomical ground truth
lineage.transforms_and_model_ancestry: Exact conversion/registration transforms, preprocessing execution revision and any model dependence are unresolved; no anatomical-fidelity claim.

transport.initial_request: Ordinary verified-HTTPS whole-object GET with identity encoding, no range and no redirect; require HTTP 200 and exact Content-Length.
transport.resume: Only after a retained partial from a real attempt; request bytes=N-(total-1). Require HTTP 206 with exactly bytes N-(total-1)/total and Content-Length total-N before appending staged bytes. Never append a 200 response to an existing prefix.
transport.range_failure_behavior: Retain prefix and failure state, refuse append; do not silently restart or use remote ZIP extraction.
transport.final_fixity: Exact 14,471,900,926 bytes and published MD5 360bc61e2320d5c5a7145454a81c566a; additionally measure local SHA256 before atomic publication.
transport.persistent_state: One writer lock, source/manifest/helper/client hashes, attempt intents, response headers, elapsed/bytes, cooldowns, results, staged suffixes, append journals, failure/interruption receipts and completion fixity. Never reset attempt count on restart.
transport.byte_only: No ZIP extraction, NIfTI reading, overview viewing, registration, training or tuning.

bounds.retry_after: Honor longer server Retry-After; persist and defer if beyond campaign deadline.
bounds.scope_includes: All retained partial, staged, verified and metadata/log files, hardlink-inode deduplicated; no decompression allocation.
bounds.disk_reservation: Existing helper conservatively reserves two times remaining source bytes plus 65,536 before each attempt; initial reservation 28,943,867,388 bytes fits 32 GiB.

implementation.new_binding_needed: New one-archive Queue constructor and attempts validator, manifest/proof/source/client binding and minimal driver. Do not invoke existing RESECT load_manifest/worker/run/CLI or alter module globals; its scope is fixed to RESECT.
remaining_transfer_prerequisites: Root freezes/copies these declarations and portable proofs before payload access.
Implement narrow new runner/Queue binding and focused offline controls using unchanged tested transfer functions.
Verify preflight source/role/proof/helper/client binding and resource counters, then run continuously within bounds.
